title: Typed server config module and structured JSON logging
objective: Build the two cross-cutting server libraries every later task depends on: src/server/lib/config (typed, validated environment configuration — the sole access path to env vars/secrets) and src/server/lib/logging (structured JSON logger with correlation-id support, safe for Vercel runtime logs) (M-01, A-5, N-08).
scope: lib/config: zod-validated env schema covering the static-tier catalog — DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (server-side uses), CRON_SECRET, INTERNAL_JOB_SECRET, API_KEY_PEPPER (Q-19), NODE_ENV/APP_ENV (local|preview|staging|production); fail-fast on missing/invalid; server-only module (never imported by client code)

lib/logging: structured JSON to stdout; fields correlation_id, user_id, tenant_id, route/job, status, duration_ms; child-logger/context pattern; redaction guarantees (never tokens, auth headers, passwords, secrets, sensitive insurance data)
Correlation-id generation/propagation helper (request header passthrough or new UUID)
Unit tests for config validation and logger redaction/shape
out_of_scope: Supabase Vault tier (explicitly deferred per Q-23 — no secrets-module surface for it)
implementation_details: config: export a getConfig(): AppConfig singleton-per-invocation pattern that parses process.env once per cold start; typed AppConfig interface; no direct process.env access anywhere else (lint rule or convention test).
SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET intentionally absent (A-10). ERROR_TRACKING_DSN intentionally absent (Q-13).

logging: minimal hand-rolled logger (no new deps) — log(level, message, context) emitting single-line JSON; helpers requestLogger(correlationId, userId, tenantId) and jobLogger(jobName, correlationId, environment).
Redaction: an explicit deny-list serializer test proving Authorization headers/token-like fields never serialize.
Environment stamp: logger includes env (from config) so job records and logs are environment-identified (N-08).

unit: config: valid env parses to typed config; missing required var fails fast with clear message; unknown APP_ENV rejected
logging: emitted JSON contains correlation/tenant/user fields; redaction denies token/authorization/password keys; single-line output
